title: How does mech interp relate to AI safety?

cues.en: In this video, I will go into more detail about the potential of mechanistic interpretability on AI
cues.zh: 這支深入談機制可解釋性，對 AI

cues.en: safety, because mechanistic interpretability is such a new and rapidly developing field, as is AI
cues.zh: 安全的潛力。它是很新、快速發展的領域，AI

cues.en: safety and of course, AI itself, it's not really clear exactly how or even whether interpretability can directly lead to AI safety improvements.
cues.zh: 安全、AI 本身也是，所以不清楚究竟如何，甚至是否能直接改善安全。

cues.en: Of course, the claims that AI will make in this video are all very sensible, but it's just too new.
cues.zh: 當然，我這支的說法很合理，但仍太新。

cues.en: It's too early to have made an established track record that someone could point at, and prove.
cues.zh: 太早，還沒有足夠紀錄，能明確證明，

cues.en: That mechanistic interpretability led to immediate and measurable increases in AI safety.
cues.zh: 機制可解釋性帶來立即、可量測的安全提升，

cues.en: The way that, for example, you could point to seatbelts in cars and say that those had an immediate and measurable increase in car safety.
cues.zh: 就像能指出汽車安全帶，確實立即、可量測地改善安全。

cues.en: On the other hand, you could make the same criticism for almost every current approach to AI safety.
cues.zh: 但幾乎每種現行安全方法，都能受同樣批評。

cues.en: In fact, it's even possible to make some arguments that in the long term, mechanistic interpretability
cues.zh: 甚至能主張，長期而言，機制可解釋性

cues.en: may even increase the risks of AI rather than decrease them.
cues.zh: 可能增加而非降低風險。

cues.en: But let me start with the arguments for how MacIntyre can increase safety.
cues.zh: 先談如何提升安全。

cues.en: Here's the thing.
cues.zh: 是這樣。

cues.en: If an AI system is capable of harmful or dangerous behavior, then those behaviors or capabilities must
cues.zh: 如果 AI 能做有害、危險行為，這些能力

cues.en: be represented and calculated in the model somewhere, somehow.
cues.zh: 一定以某種方式，在模型某處表徵、計算。

cues.en: At present, we mostly don't know where and how the action of, for example, giving someone a recipe to make a bomb is stored in the network.
cues.zh: 目前，大多不知道例如提供炸彈配方的行為，在哪裡、如何儲存。

cues.en: Of course, it's straightforward to monitor the model's outputs to see if there are output tokens that are consistent with harmful behavior.
cues.zh: 當然，很容易監測輸出，看是否有符合有害行為的詞元。

cues.en: But if we could find the exact mechanism and circuit in the model that stores either that specific piece
cues.zh: 但若找到儲存特定資訊，或模型願意

cues.en: of information, or perhaps the willingness of a model to help with harmful or illegal activity, then
cues.zh: 幫助有害、非法行為的確切機制、迴路，

cues.en: AI developers could either just remove that circuit, or possibly install a monitoring system in the model that would detect the activation of that harmful circuit.
cues.zh: 開發者就能移除，或加監測，偵測該有害迴路啟動。

cues.en: Now, that is not the the sort of thing that is currently possible, at least not at the scale of modern commercial frontier llms and not for real applications.
cues.zh: 目前還做不到，至少現代商用前沿模型、實際應用的規模不行。

cues.en: But this is the sort of thing that mechanistic interpretability hopes to discover, and would be a direct translation of misinterpret to AI safety.
cues.zh: 但這是希望發現的，也能直接轉化成安全改善。

cues.en: Another way that mech interp can help safety is that if we can understand how llms process information
cues.zh: 另一種，是理解 LLM 內部處理，

cues.en: internally, then we can communicate our values to llms more directly and accurately.
cues.zh: 就能更直接、準確地傳達價值。

cues.en: An analogy here is that let's say your native language is Spanish, and you're trying to communicate with someone whose native language is Chinese.
cues.zh: 類比來說，你母語西班牙文，要和中文母語者溝通。

cues.en: Now, if you don't speak Chinese and they don't speak Spanish, there's no way for you to communicate directly.
cues.zh: 你不會中文，他不會西文，就無法直接交流。

cues.en: But if both of you know at least a little bit of English, then you can communicate through English.
cues.zh: 若都懂一點英文，就能用英文。

cues.en: Of course, if neither of you speaks English very well, then that communication is just really inefficient and you're likely to have a lot of misunderstandings and limited communication.
cues.zh: 但都不太好，溝通就沒效率，容易誤會、受限。

cues.en: Anyway, in previous sections of this course, you learned about quantitative evaluations of llms,
cues.zh: 前面學量化評估，

cues.en: and you learned that all eval methods have limitations and disadvantages.
cues.zh: 也知道所有方法有限制、缺點。

cues.en: Imagine that you could assess a model's capabilities and biases and unfair tendencies directly, without
cues.zh: 想像能直接評估能力、偏見、不公平傾向，

cues.en: having to give it a test with questionable reliability.
cues.zh: 不用可靠性可疑的測驗。

cues.en: And even better, you could identify the exact circuitry in the model that is responsible for the capabilities
cues.zh: 更好的是，找到負責特定能力、偏見的確切迴路，

cues.en: or the biases, and then immediately, directly and accurately just fine tune the model only to work on those circuits.
cues.zh: 立即、直接、準確地只微調那些迴路。

cues.en: That would be incredible.
cues.zh: 非常驚人。

cues.en: Again, that is not currently possible, but that is one of the goals of mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 同樣，目前不行，但這是目標之一。

cues.en: Now I will describe a few speculations about how MacIntyre might actually decrease AI safety.
cues.zh: 現在談幾個可能降低安全的推測。

cues.en: Now, to be clear, all the points on this slide are speculative ideas about something that might happen in the future, but I do think it's worth taking these concerns seriously.
cues.zh: 先說，這張都是未來可能發生的推測，但值得認真考慮。

cues.en: So in the previous slide, I implicitly suggested that MEC Interp can actually accelerate AI development
cues.zh: 上一張隱含說，機制可解釋性可透過精準方法，

cues.en: by allowing us to measure, fine tune and improve AI systems using precise and targeted methods.
cues.zh: 測量、微調、改善系統，加速開發。

cues.en: Well, if you are generally concerned about risks posed by more advanced AI systems, then mechanistic
cues.zh: 若擔心更先進系統的風險，那機制

cues.en: interpretability will increase risks simply by also increasing the speed of development.
cues.zh: 可解釋性單因加速發展，也會增加風險。

cues.en: Also, the flip side of being able to identify and resect specific circuits that are responsible for
cues.zh: 另一方面，能找出、切除造成

cues.en: a bias or unfair behavior in the model is that those same methods could be used to delete knowledge,
cues.zh: 偏見、不公平的迴路，同樣方法也能刪除知識，

cues.en: actual factual historical knowledge, or just, you know, adjust the model to be more unfair as a way
cues.zh: 真正歷史事實，或讓模型更不公平，

cues.en: to censor information or to use propaganda to spread disinformation.
cues.zh: 用來審查資訊、宣傳、散播假訊息。

cues.en: And the final, more general point is that if mechanistic interpretability turns out to be interesting,
cues.zh: 最後，更一般地說，如果這領域只是有趣，

cues.en: but ultimately just curiosity based and an academic endeavor, then it means that all of the resources
cues.zh: 卻終究只是好奇心驅動的學術活動，就代表所有資源、

cues.en: and the funding and the smart people who have been working on and spending time on mcinturff, they
cues.zh: 經費、聰明人才，花在這裡，

cues.en: are not working on something that's more directly applicable to AI safety.
cues.zh: 而沒做更直接有助安全的事。

cues.en: Now, this last concern is based on the unfortunate fact that very, very little funding and attention
cues.zh: 這個擔憂基於一個不幸事實：相較 AI 開發，

cues.en: actually goes to support AI safety research compared to the amount of funding that goes to AI development
cues.zh: 安全研究得到的經費、注意力非常少，

cues.en: and the funding that does go to AI safety research does get split between safety and interp.
cues.zh: 還要在安全與可解釋性間分配。

cues.en: And although it certainly is the case that Mcinturff has a goal of improving AI safety, it is certainly
cues.zh: 雖然機制可解釋性確實以安全為目標，

cues.en: not the case that all mech interp gets translated into actionable safety.
cues.zh: 但並非全部研究，都能轉成可行動的安全措施。

cues.en: So that's it for this video.
cues.zh: 這支到這裡。

cues.en: I think it's important to be realistic and critical without being overly dismissive or pessimistic about
cues.zh: 重要的是，務實、批判，而不過度否定、悲觀，

cues.en: the possible impact of mechanistic interpretability on improving AI safety and beneficial use.
cues.zh: 看待改善安全、有益使用的潛力。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the beginning of the video, everything related to AI and Llms is still so new and
cues.zh: 如開頭說，AI、LLM 一切都很新，

cues.en: developing so quickly that it's just really hard to make very firm statements, especially things that might relate to the future.
cues.zh: 發展太快，很難做確定陳述，尤其未來。

cues.en: But in my opinion, that's also a good thing, because it means that every new researcher, maybe even
cues.zh: 但我覺得也是好事，因為每位新研究者，甚至

cues.en: new to the field, has the potential to steer the field in one particular direction.
cues.zh: 剛進領域，都有機會引導它往某個方向。
